items.summary: Elections are typically framed as a choice for voters. For Palestinian citizens of Israel, however, the country’s national ballots pose more of a dilemma. Constituting about one-sixth of eligible voters in Israel, Palestinian citizens could hold the difference in a race expected to be close . But voting involves a trade-off: By casting a ballot for their best interests, many Palestinian citizens believe they also risk legitimizing a process that seeks to silence their voice and a system that treats their citizenship as conditional . The coming Israeli election on Oct. 27, 2026 , brings that tension to a new peak. items.title: Cyclone Arnab makes landfall near Andhra coast, brings destructive winds and heavy rain
items.summary: Very severe cyclonic storm Arnab continued to cross the Andhra Pradesh coast on October 28 morning, bringing destructive winds and torrential rain that uprooted trees, damaged electricity infrastructure and inundated low-lying areas. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) said the landfall process was expected to continue for several more hours. The storm began crossing the coast in the early hours of October 28, near the stretch between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam, close to south of Yanam. The IMD reported sustained wind speeds of 125 to 135 kmph, with gusts reaching 150 kmph. Its northern spiral band had moved further inland, while the centre remained close to the coastline. North coastal Andhra Pradesh recorded extremely heavy rainfall overnight. Kannuripalem in Anakapalli district received around 263 mm of rain in the 24 hours ending at 8 am on October 28, according to the state Directorate of Economics and Statistics. Bhogapuram in Vizianagaram district recorded a similar amount, while a police battalion campus in Visakhapatnam received around 260 mm. Thirty-nine automatic weather stations across Anakapalli, Visakhapatnam and Vizianagaram districts recorded more than 204.5 mm

items.title: CAT slams Railway officials for twisting former Solicitor General's undertaking to Supreme Court
items.summary: The Jaipur bench of the Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT) has criticised railway officials for attempting to circumvent an undertaking given by former Solicitor General Ranjit Kumar before the Supreme Court regarding promotions of reserved-category employees against unreserved vacancies. [Puncham Singh Vs UoI]. A bench of judicial member Ranjana Shahi and administrative member Lok Ranjan observed that certain sections of the Railways were deliberately attempting to reinterpret judicial pronouncements and the undertaking given by the Solicitor General. " However, certain sections within the respondent-department are trying to deliberately find ways to interpret / define and twist the above-cited judgments as well as the specific undertaking by their own Solicitor General ," the CAT said. The observations came while allowing three applications filed by railway employees challenging the promotion of reserved-category candidates against unreserved vacancies. The dispute concerned whether employees who had entered service through reservation or obtained promotions against reserved vacancies could subsequently claim promotion against unreserved posts on the basis of their own merit.

items.title: Rough waves disrupt Ennore Expressway in Chennai as Cyclone Arnab hits AP
items.summary: Rough waves driven by Cyclone Arnab surged over the shoreline and onto the Ennore Expressway in north Chennai on the evening of October 27, disrupting traffic, pushing vehicles off the road and sweeping away roadside stalls. The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has now closed the affected stretch of the Ennore Expressway. Videos circulating on social media showed cars, autorickshaws and two-wheelers being drenched by waves, while some smaller vehicles were pushed by the water’s force. The Ennore Expressway connects Ennore with Kasimedu harbour and is used by trucks travelling to the port as well as residents of Kasimedu, Tollgate, Thiruvottiyur and Ennore. Police diverted traffic to prevent accidents. According to Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC), vehicles travelling from Ramakrishna Nagar to Annai Sivagami Nagar were directed via Ernavur Bridge, Murugar Kovil Road and Kathivakkam Beach. Vehicles from Thazhakuppam and Ennore were diverted via Kathivakkam Bridge and Murugar Kovil Road.
